d: Bihar ke buniyadi dhanche aur kanektiviti ko naee raphtar dene vala ganga nadi par nirmit chhah len vala bhavy pul ab 'nitish setu' ke nam se jana jaega. aagami 21 navanbar ko pradhanmantri narendr modi is mahatvakankshi pul ka vidhivat udghatan karenge. is aitihasik phaisle par janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh aur rajyasbha sansad sanjay kumar jha ne prasannata vyakt karte hue ise pure bihar ke lie gaurav aur pratishtha ka vishay bataya hai.
